credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe holding a rock sitting on the ground in a long sleeved striped dress wearing her PF Flyer sneakers.  A Swissair travel tote is at her feet and a woman is looking at rocks behind her. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Sitting Holding a Rock
